title: a fixable CRITICAL in a shipped image stops the release gates; the two third-party pins
note: basis 'shown' means shown by public registry metadata, the Go vulnerability database and upstream tags read on 2026-11-27, or by the card's unit test; nothing was pulled or scanned.

findings.claim: no published release of the proxy image fixes CVE-2026-78661: its newest tag 2.11.9 builds with x/net v0.60.0 and the fix is v0.62.0, only on the upstream main branch
the FHIR server image has no newer patch of the pinned v8.12.0-2; the only newer image is the major release v9.0.0-1, not scanned here
the allow-list entries carry no severity, so whether any of the 62 accepts a fixable CRITICAL that the new stop will now fail is not known until the next release-gates run
